name: Alliance_get_gene
description: Get detailed gene information from the Alliance of Genome Resources, including species, synopsis, synonyms, genomic location, and paginated cross-references. Use xref_offset/xref_limit and inspect cross_references_total, cross_references_truncated, and next_xref_offset; well-studied genes can have hundreds of cross-references.

gene_id.description: Alliance gene ID with source prefix. Examples: 'HGNC:6081' (human INS), 'MGI:98834' (mouse Trp53), 'FB:FBgn0003996' (fly w), 'SGD:S000000259' (yeast GAL4), 'ZFIN:ZDB-GENE-990415-8' (zebrafish pax2a), 'WB:WBGene00006763' (worm unc-13).

secondary_ids.description: Retired accessions for the gene. Older literature cites these, and nothing else recovers them.

notes.description: Curator notes the model-organism database wrote about the gene

note_type.description: What kind of note this is, as the source database classifies it

reference_curies.description: Publication curies for the gene. Alliance lists thousands for a well-studied gene, so this is capped; reference_curies_total is the true count.

reference_curies_total.description: How many publications Alliance links to the gene

reference_curies_returned.description: How many are carried on this response

reference_curies_truncated.description: True when reference_curies is a prefix of the full list

name: Alliance_search_genes
description: Search genes across all Alliance of Genome Resources species by symbol, synonym, name, or keyword. Returns exact total_results and recoverable offset pagination; continue with next_offset while has_more is true. Results include human, mouse, rat, zebrafish, fly, worm, yeast, and frog genes. Example: 'TP53' has more than 100 cross-species and related gene matches.

query.description: Gene symbol or synonym to search for (not a descriptive name). Examples: 'INS', 'TP53', 'shh', 'notch1'.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return (1-50). Default: 10.

offset.description: Zero-based offset in the complete matching gene list. Continue with metadata.next_offset. Default: 0.

automated_description.description: Alliance's generated one-line description of the gene

search_score.description: Alliance's relevance score, which is the order the hits come back in

so_term.description: Sequence Ontology type of the hit

related_data_counts.description: How much of each kind of evidence the gene has, for picking a hit worth following up

name: Alliance_get_gene_phenotypes
description: Get phenotype annotations for a gene from the Alliance of Genome Resources. Results are recoverably paginated: start with page=1 and continue with metadata.next_page while metadata.has_more is true; metadata.total_results and total_pages are exact.

gene_id.description: Alliance gene ID with source prefix. Examples: 'HGNC:6081' (human INS), 'MGI:98834' (mouse Trp53), 'FB:FBgn0003996' (fly w).

limit.description: Maximum number of phenotypes to return (1-100). Default: 20.

mod_id.description: The model-organism database's own reference id

cross_references.description: Every curie Alliance cross-references, DOI included

inferred_allele.description: The allele the phenotype was observed in

inferred_allele_synonyms.description: Other names for that allele, which is how it is matched across databases

conditions.description: Experimental conditions the phenotype was observed under; 'standard conditions' versus a treatment changes what the statement means

name: Alliance_get_disease_genes
description: Get genes associated with a Disease Ontology term across model organisms. Results are recoverably paginated: start with page=1 and continue with metadata.next_page while metadata.has_more is true; metadata.total_results and total_pages are exact.

disease_id.description: Disease Ontology (DO) ID. Examples: 'DOID:162' (cancer), 'DOID:10652' (Alzheimer's disease), 'DOID:9351' (diabetes mellitus), 'DOID:1612' (breast cancer).

limit.description: Maximum number of gene associations to return (1-100). Default: 20.

mod_id.description: The model-organism database's own reference id

cross_references.description: Every curie Alliance cross-references, DOI included

evidence_codes.description: Evidence codes Alliance assigned to the association

evidence_code_details.description: The evidence codes as the identifiers they are cited by, beside the prose names in evidence_codes

abbreviation.description: The three-letter code, e.g. IEP, IAGP, IMP

annotation_relations.description: Each annotation's relation. 'is_implicated_in' and 'is_marker_for' are different claims about a gene-disease link - 35 and 23 on one page of DOID:162

data_providers.description: Which Alliance members asserted the annotations, e.g. RGD or OMIM

negated_annotations.description: How many annotations are NOT annotations: the gene curated as not associated with the disease. 0 across the 58 measured on DOID:162, so latent here

name: Alliance_get_disease
description: Get disease summary information from the Alliance of Genome Resources by Disease Ontology (DO) ID. Returns disease name, definition, synonyms, and classification. The Alliance integrates disease annotations from multiple model organism databases. Example: 'DOID:162' returns cancer with definition and synonyms like 'malignant neoplasm'.

disease_id.description: Disease Ontology (DO) ID. Examples: 'DOID:162' (cancer), 'DOID:10652' (Alzheimer's disease), 'DOID:9351' (diabetes mellitus), 'DOID:1612' (breast cancer).

name: Alliance_get_gene_orthologs
description: Get orthologs and paralogs of a gene across model organisms via the Alliance of Genome Resources (used by MGI, Xenbase, and other members). Returns one page of each category with true totals and explicit continuation metadata; while metadata.has_more is true, pass metadata.next_page as page with the same filters. Returns the stringent ortholog set with per-ortholog disease/expression annotation flags and prediction methods, plus the paralog set. Gene IDs use member prefixes (MGI:, HGNC:, RGD:, ZFIN:, FB:, WB:, SGD:, Xenbase:); bare WBGene/FBgn/MGI numeric IDs are auto-prefixed.

gene_id.description: Alliance gene ID with member prefix, e.g. 'MGI:97490' (Pax6), 'HGNC:8620', 'RGD:3889', 'Xenbase:XB-GENE-865965'.

page.description: One-based page number shared by the ortholog and paralog queries. Continue with metadata.next_page while metadata.has_more is true.

paralog_gene_id.description: Alliance curie of the paralogous gene

paralog_species.description: Species, which for a paralog is the query's own

similarity_percent.description: Sequence similarity percent of the pair

identity_percent.description: Sequence identity percent of the pair

rank.description: Alliance's rank of this paralog for the query gene; 1 is closest

methods.description: Prediction methods that called the pair

methods_not_matched.description: Methods that ran and did not call it, which is what makes the method count interpretable

methods_not_called.description: Methods that did not call the pair

name: Alliance_get_molecular_interactions
description: Get molecular (physical) interactions for a gene via the Alliance of Genome Resources, including evidence references. Results are recoverably paginated: start with page=1 and continue with metadata.next_page while metadata.has_more is true; metadata.total_results and total_pages are exact.

gene_id.description: Alliance gene ID with member prefix, e.g. 'MGI:97490' (Pax6), 'HGNC:8620'.

references.description: The publications behind this interaction. Empty when Alliance reports none.

mod_id.description: The model-organism database's own reference id, e.g. FB:FBrf0238983

citation.description: Short citation, e.g. 'Wang XC (2018) Eur J Cell Biol 97(4):308-317'

cross_references.description: Every curie Alliance cross-references, DOI included

relation.description: The association's own relation, e.g. genetically_interacts_with

subject_role.description: The queried gene's part in the interaction, e.g. 'suppressed gene'. Without it an interaction type names a pair but not a direction.

interactor_role.description: The partner gene's part, e.g. 'suppressor gene'

subject_type.description: Interactor type of the queried gene, e.g. 'gene', 'protein'

interaction_source.description: The database that asserted the interaction, e.g. MI:0478 flybase

name: Alliance_get_alleles_and_models
description: Get alleles/variants and affected genomic models (mutant strains) for a gene via the Alliance of Genome Resources (mouse/MGI, frog/Xenbase, and other members). Returns one page of each category with true totals and explicit continuation metadata; while metadata.has_more is true, pass metadata.next_page as page with the same filters. Returns allele/variant records with HGVS genomic locations and disease/phenotype flags, plus affected genomic models (genotypes/strains).

gene_id.description: Alliance gene ID with member prefix, e.g. 'MGI:97490' (Pax6), 'HGNC:8620'.

page.description: One-based page number shared by the allele and model queries. Continue with metadata.next_page while metadata.has_more is true.

locations.description: Curated genomic locations of the variant

most_severe_consequence.description: The most severe predicted consequence at this location

transcript.description: The transcript the consequence is predicted on, e.g. XM_073919248.1

vep_impact.description: VEP impact class: HIGH, MODERATE, LOW, MODIFIER

sequence_feature.description: The change as the source states it, e.g. c.396+1G>A

variants_total.description: How many variants the record has, as opposed to how many are carried

model_curie.description: The curie Alliance's endpoints take for the model

phenotypes.description: The phenotypes associated with this record. A hasPhenotype boolean beside no phenotypes is a success beside no data.
